issue_title: [Bug] Todo.rename() method exists but is not exposed via CLI - users cannot rename tod
implementation_summary: Added 'rename' subcommand to CLI exposing the existing Todo.rename() method. The implementation includes: (1) TodoApp.rename() method that finds todo by id, calls todo.rename(), and saves; (2) Parser arguments for 'rename <id> <text>'; (3) Command handler in run_command() that prints confirmation message.
test_summary: Added 5 regression tests covering: valid rename, updated_at timestamp change, non-existent id error, empty text error, whitespace-only text error.
